reconciled_inputs.ebit_basis_note: EBIT = company non-GAAP gross profit - non-GAAP operating expense - D&A = GAAP loss from operations + SBC + severance + IPO-related bonus and transaction costs - the 2025 non-monetary gain (Ex.99.1 reconciliations). Q2 2026: -8.727 + 3.557 = -5.170 = 15.989 - 19.374 - 1.785 [5]. The company's own non-GAAP figures exclude D&A as well as SBC, so its "non-GAAP operating loss" (GP - opex) is EBITDA-like; this set deducts D&A to keep EBIT an EBIT (engine ebitda = ebit + da = the company figure). EPS in notes = company non-GAAP net loss per share (excl. SBC and D&A, incl. other income) on weighted basic shares, the basis of the guide and Street (StockAnalysis/Benzinga). Engine model EPS = EBIT / diluted shares (no other income) and is lower; Zacks figures are on a different, GAAP-like basis.

Q4 2026 total 44.3: the company sets the 43.5-44.5 guide from 'customer forecasts and order activity' with capacity secured for 'a meaningful step-up' [49,51]; it does not say how much of the range orders in hand cover. Q3 shipped 38.1, +1.6 (+4.4%) over its guide midpoint while supply-constrained, helped by expedites (CTO: 'in a couple of cases we were able to use expedites ... not always something we can count on' [51]); for Q4 the CEO says short-lead upside demand exceeded available capacity ('certain demand that we couldn't completely fill' [51]). That bounds the Q4 overage at about 0 to +1.6 over the 44.0 midpoint (44.0-45.6): capacity, not demand, limits the quarter and expedites are not assured, so no Q3-size overage is assumed. The set books 44.3 (midpoint + 0.3, +0.7%), the conservative end of that range (house rule), under the smallest past beat (+2.3% over 5 prints [1-5,49]); the low-end 43.5 and the full-overage 45.6 builds are sized in judgment_alternatives. judgment_calls_for_kilian.question: FY2027-28 revenue: book the moderate bottom-up path, the old +28.9% growth for FY28-29, or a faster 2027?
judgment_calls_for_kilian.context: us_rev carries the total net-sales build (US = total - China - RoW), the input the EV/NTM-sales leg reads: the horizon NTM window (Nov-2027..Oct-2028) is mostly FY2028. The set books FY2027 188.8 (+33.5%: the Q4 2026 guide-based rate of 44.3 a quarter carried in, plus ~12% in-year growth from units, Apollo5 ASP mix and new customers) and FY2028 218.8 (+15.9%: non-wearables stepping from mid-single digits to low double digits of revenue as management said on the 2026-11-10 call, wearables core +8.5% on CCS Insight's ~3% smartwatch unit growth plus content). There is no 2027 guide (it comes on the Q1 2027 call), the only consensus is pre-print (FY2027 178.43, 2026-10-07) and FY2028 consensus is paywalled, so the level is judgment; the old set's +28.9% FY28-29 was a carried growth rate with no outside case and is dropped under the no-carried-paths rule. Research target (12m) on the booked path $47.66.

options.label: Booked: moderate bottom-up (FY27 188.8, FY28 218.8)
options.reasoning: Q4 run-rate carry-in plus named in-year sources for 2027; for 2028 management's own non-wearables mix statement and an end market growing ~3% a year in units (smartwatch -4% in 2026, gradual recovery in 2027, rings +32% a year from a small base). Leans conservative (house rule) while the supply cap and 79% top-4 concentration persist.

options.label: Old +28.9% a year for FY2028-29 (243.4 / 313.7)
options.reasoning: Growth stays near the 2027 rate because Atomiq110 (sampling Q1 2027) and Apollo340 (sampling 2027) add new sockets on top of the Apollo5 migration, and the company has beaten every revenue guide by +2.3% to +16.6%. Against it: the rate is the old FY27 consensus growth carried forward, not a market or share case; wearables units are flat to slightly up.

options.label: Faster 2027: +5% sequential (FY27 ~200.5)
options.reasoning: CEO: customer projections 'extremely strong even into 2027' with both quantity and ASP rising; H2 2026 sequential steps were +12.5% and +16%, so +5% a quarter is still a sharp slowdown; seven $1M+ customers vs three a year ago. Against it: supply is still constrained and short-lead demand went unfilled in Q4.

options.label: Supply-bound 2027 at the Q4 exit rate (177.2)
options.reasoning: If capacity stays the binding limit (CEO: some demand left unfilled; expedites not always available), 2027 output holds near 44.3 a quarter with no in-year growth; FY28 follows on the set's growth. Against it: the company secured capacity for a +16% Q4 step and says supply partners will keep supporting 2027 demand.

options.label: Pre-print Street FY2027 178.43
options.reasoning: The last published consensus (7 analysts, 2026-10-07) as an outside view; it predates the beat and raise (FY26 135.2 vs ~140 now), so it is likely to move up and sits below the Q4 exit run-rate.

judgment_calls_for_kilian.why: It is the only path built from named, sized causes (carry-in, units, ASP mix, non-wearables mix) with outside data; the old +28.9% has no outside case and the faster 2027 needs the supply cap to lift. Re-check against the FY2027 guide on the Q1 2027 call and the first post-print consensus.
